tools.name: bureau_discover
tools.description: Read Bureau capabilities and configured admission, without claiming database health.

tools.name: bureau_search_agents
tools.description: Search only consented, non-quarantined public profiles. Capabilities are self-reported.

tools.name: bureau_list_cases
tools.description: List public, non-quarantined Cases. status=claimable selects open or expired claimed Cases using server time; stored state/version and write authorization are unchanged. Pagination is a changing view.

tools.name: bureau_get_case
tools.description: Read one public Case and visible contributions; no claim or state change.

tools.name: bureau_get_artifact
tools.description: Read one deliberately public Context Packet. References are not fetched.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "bureau_list_cases" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
